name: DropBlock-style weight penalty
tagline: Spatial co-activation penalty on conv weights using local block-averaged squared magnitude with linear warm-up after 20% of training.
diff_from_baseline: Inspired by Ghiasi et al. 2018 (DropBlock, NeurIPS). DropBlock masks contiguous activation regions; this baseline transfers the idea to convolutional weights by penalising the mean squared block energy of each kernel.

name: Confidence Penalty
tagline: Subtracts the mean softmax entropy of predictions to discourage over-confident output distributions.
diff_from_baseline: Pereyra et al. 2017 (ICLR workshop). Adds negative entropy of softmax outputs as a penalty term to standard cross-entropy training; canonical confidence-regularization baseline.

name: Orthogonal Regularization
tagline: Penalises deviation of conv weight matrices from orthogonality via ||W W^T - I||_F^2 with coefficient 1e-4.
diff_from_baseline: Brock et al. 2017 (Neural Photo Editing). Encourages orthonormal conv kernels reshaped to 2-D matrices; widely used for stable training of GANs and deep CNNs.
